blocks.text: KORONADAL CITY — Several local government units (LGUs) in South Cotabato have suspended face-to-face classes on Monday, Sept. 21, as schools review safety and security measures following the shooting at Banga National High School (BNHS) last Friday. The local governments of Banga, Lake Sebu, Tantangan, Norala, Sto. Niño and Surallah, as well as Koronadal City, announced the suspensions through advisories and announcements posted on their official social media accounts. In Banga, Mayor Albert Palencia suspended classes at all levels in public and private schools on Monday to ensure the safety and security of students and school personnel.
